title: Story-mode weapon census: {labels}
summary: A census of weapons that only appear in Story levels (the Map Maker does not offer them). One game session in ONE Story level: an idle control, then one phase per label you gave on the command line. A label is a name YOU choose ([a-z0-9_]), it only names the phase, so say in your report which weapon each label was. Each run writes a new session folder tmp/owner-profiles/story-weapons-<timestamp>, so a re-run never overwrites an earlier one.
duration: about 3 minutes per weapon after the game is up, plus the time to reach the level
prerequisites: Game HDD tmp/hdds/profile-hdd (your Story profile). The script builds the private host first, which takes a few minutes.

Choose a Story level where ALL the weapons of this run are available and stay in that same level for every phase. Known: TNT is in the second level, near the start. For the other weapons the level is not recorded anywhere, you have to know it.

steps.text: Press Enter in this terminal at 'Enter = start the game'. When the window opens drive to the Story level yourself: start, your profile, Story mode, the level, and play until you can move and the first weapon is within reach. Nothing is measured until you continue at a phase prompt.
substeps: For tnt that is the second Story level, near the start.
Get the weapon in your hands during the throwaway step before the prompt (find or pick it up, D-pad right/left to equip it).
Use ONLY that weapon for the window (fire, throw, or place and detonate, as it normally works), then stop. Note the buttons on the console.

note_at_end: Which weapon each label really was (its name on screen), and the level you used.
The buttons for placing, throwing, detonating or any alternative mode.
If the game stopped: the 'unimplemented instruction at ...' or STOP line it prints.
stop: At every phase prompt: continue with Enter in this terminal, which starts and again ends a phase. s skips it, q finishes the session. The idle phase stops by itself.
Close the game window only after the last phase (or q): a phase in progress is lost.
send_back: Tell Claude the session finished: the folder tmp/owner-profiles/story-weapons-... the script printed (the analysis tables are printed at the end).

ingame-idle.title: Idle control in the Story level, before the weapons
ingame-idle.go_to: The Story level you loaded, standing still where you can move, holding what you hold at the start
ingame-idle.do: Stand still. Press no button, do not move the stick, do not pick up or switch to anything. The session stops this phase by itself after 20 s.

ingame-fire.title: Use the weapon {label}
ingame-fire.go_to: The Story level where the weapon {label} is available, the weapon in your hands
ingame-fire.switch: the weapon you named {label} (find or pick it up in this level, then D-pad right/left until it is in your hands)
ingame-fire.do: Use ONLY the weapon {label}, the way it normally works (fire it, throw it, or place and detonate it). Do not switch weapon, do not use anything else.
ingame-fire.note: the buttons you pressed for {label}, and which weapon {label} really was (its name on screen)

ingame-fire:tnt.title: Use TNT
ingame-fire:tnt.go_to: The second Story level, near the start, the TNT in your hands
ingame-fire:tnt.switch: the TNT (find or pick it up in this level, then D-pad right/left until it is in your hands)
ingame-fire:tnt.do: Place a TNT charge and detonate it, the way it normally works, then place the next one, repeat. Use only the TNT, stay clear of the blast.
ingame-fire:tnt.note: the button to place it and the button to detonate it

ingame-fire:time_grenade.title: Throw the time grenade
ingame-fire:time_grenade.go_to: The Story level where the time grenade is available, it in your hands
ingame-fire:time_grenade.switch: the time grenade (pick it up, then D-pad right/left until it is in your hands)
ingame-fire:time_grenade.do: Throw the grenade only (RT), wait until it goes off, throw the next one, repeat. Do not move far or switch weapon.
ingame-fire:time_grenade.note: what the grenade does when it goes off and what its name is on screen

ingame-fire:monkey_gun.title: Fire the monkey gun
ingame-fire:monkey_gun.go_to: The Story level where the monkey gun is available, it in your hands
ingame-fire:monkey_gun.switch: the monkey gun (pick it up, then D-pad right/left until it is in your hands)
ingame-fire:monkey_gun.do: Fire the monkey gun only (hold or tap RT). Do not move far or switch weapon.
ingame-fire:monkey_gun.note: what it fires, and its name on screen

ingame-fire:scifi_rocket.title: Fire the sci-fi rocket launcher
ingame-fire:scifi_rocket.go_to: The Story level where the sci-fi rocket launcher is available, it in your hands
ingame-fire:scifi_rocket.switch: the rocket launcher (pick it up, then D-pad right/left until it is in your hands)
ingame-fire:scifi_rocket.do: Fire rockets only (RT), wait until they hit, repeat. Do not move far or switch weapon.
ingame-fire:scifi_rocket.note: whether the rockets home, any alternative fire mode, and its name on screen

steps: tnt: TNT. Place a charge and detonate it the way it works, repeat. Note the button to place and the button to detonate. It is available in the second Story level, near the start.
time_grenade: a thrown grenade. Throw it and wait until it goes off, repeat.
